body: Owner asked 2026-11-11 (screenshot of `sati brief` and `sati doctor` in kory). On a TTY: colour, aligned columns cut to the terminal width, symbols, summaries, readable activity and record views, grouped root help. Piped output stays compact for agents and scripts. Strip terminal control characters from stored text before printing. Brief: a long review list must not push every ready task out. Work in worktree branch cli-output; another agent holds main.

completion.releaseNote: CLI output is laid out for a terminal (colour, aligned tables, grouped help) and stays compact in a pipe; stored text can no longer inject terminal escapes.
completion.summary: Branch cli-output (worktree ../sati-cli-output), commit 78cc4e4, rebased on main 4de9d1d; not merged. Rich layout when stdout is a terminal (aligned tables cut to width, colour, symbols, local times, wrapped records, doctor summary, readable activity/projects/settings/locks/comments/cards); piped output unchanged. NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR/TERM=dumb and --no-color. Own help renderer (help.ts): grouped root help, aliases merged, no colour into a pipe. Did-you-mean for command words, quiet EPIPE. Stored text cleaned of escape sequences, control characters and bidi overrides in text output; --json untouched. Brief fit(): per-section floor (2, Ready 5). Checks: lint, typecheck, 799 unit tests pass (2 skipped, platform-only, as before); 26 new tests. Not run: Playwright e2e, bench script. Not built: completions, pager, pickers (docs/ideas.md). Decision dec_8qxp93.

title: CLI output redesign: TTY styling, aligned tables, grouped help, safe text, brief budget
